brief:
Israeli settlers assaulted a child near Tamoum, Shehab Wire reported. The attack left the child injured, though the severity of the wounds was not specified in initial reports of the incident.

The assault took place in an area where confrontations between Palestinian residents and Israeli settlers have occurred repeatedly. Tamoum lies in a region where such clashes over land access and settlement expansion have become frequent flashpoints.

Authorities did not immediately release further details about the circumstances surrounding the attack, the identity of those responsible, or the exact location where the incident occurred near the settlement.
